title.narrative: Niger Integrated Urban Development and Multi-sectoral Resilience Project

description.narrative: The Project Development Objective is to increase resilience to floods, and improve urban management and access to basic services in selected municipalities in Niger.

The development objectives of Commercialization and De-Risking for Agricultural Transformation Project for Rwanda are to increase the use of irrigation and commercialization among producers and agribusiness firms in supported value chains, and to increase access to agricultural finance. This project has four components. 1) The first component, Value Chain and Infrastructure Development, has the following sub-components: (i) Irrigation rehabilitation and development; (ii) Land husbandry; and (iii) Innovation and services for agri-business value chain development. 2) The second component, Agricultural Finance and Insurance, has the following sub-components: (i) Scaling up agricultural finance; and (ii) Strengthening agricultural insurance. 3) The third component, Project Management, will ensure the smooth implementation of the project. 5) The fourth component, Contingency Emergency Response Component (CERC), will allow for rapid reallocation of the project's uncommitted funds in the event of an eligible emergency.

condition.narrative: ESCP: Adopt and implement the respective RAP and/or LP, including ensuring that before taking possession of the land and relatedassets, full compensation has been provided and, as applicable, displaced people have been resettled and moving allowances havebeen provided.
ESCP: Adopt final ESIAs and ESMPs prior to launching the bidding process for the works and thereafter implement the respectiveESMP throughout Project implementation.
ESCP: Adopt the CHMP, as part of the ESMP, before launching the bidding process for the respective subprojects, and thereafterimplement the CHMP throughout Project implementation.

ESPC: No later than 2 months after the Effective Date of the project: At the national level, renew the mandate of the environmentalspecialist who is already at the Niger Disaster Risk Manager and Urban Development PIU

Financing Agreement Schedule 2, Section I A. 2(a): The Recipient shall, not later than fifteen (15) days after the Effective Date,establish and thereafter maintain, throughout the Project implementation period, with composition, mandate and resourcessatisfactory to the Association, a steering committee, to be chaired by a representative of the Recipient's Prime Minister's officeand co-chaired by a representative of the Recipient's Ministry of Interior, as further described in the Project ImplementationManual (“Project Steering Committee”).

Financing Agreement Schedule 2, Section I A. 3(d):The Recipient, through the PIU, shall, not later than two (2) months after theEffective Date, recruit and thereafter maintain, throughout the Project implementation period: (i) a social specialist with genderand inclusion expertise; (ii) a gender-based violence (GBV) specialist; and (iii) a decentralization specialist; all with terms ofreference, qualifications and experience satisfactory to the Association.

Financing Agreement Schedule 2, Section I A. 3(e): The Recipient, through the PIU, shall, not later than three (3) months after theEffective Date: (i) recruit and thereafter maintain, throughout the Project implementation period: (A) two (2) procurementspecialists; and (B) an internal auditor; all with terms of reference, qualifications and experience satisfactory to theAssociation; (ii) update the existing accounting software for the management of the Project, with specifications acceptable to theAssociation; and (iii) deploy the existing accounting software in the Regional Offices.

Financing Agreement Schedule 2, Section I A. 3(f): The Recipient, through the PCU, shall, not later than six (6) months after theEffective Date, recruit and thereafter maintain, throughout the Project implementation period an external auditor, whosequalification, experience and terms of reference shall be acceptable to the Association.

Financing Agreement Schedule 2, Section I A. 4(a): The Recipient shall: (i) at all times during the Project implementation period,maintain the existing five (5) regional offices of the PIU, and (ii) not later than fifteen (15) days after the Effective Date,establish and thereafter maintain two (2) additional regional offices of the PIU in Zinder and Maradi; all under terms ofreference, staffing and mandate satisfactory to the Association (together the “Regional Offices”); as further elaborated in theProject Implementation Manual and which shall be responsible for supporting the technical implementation of Project activities atthe regional level in the Target Regions and for leading dialogues with local stakeholders.

Financing Agreement Schedule 2, Section I A. 4(b): The Recipient, through the PIU, shall, not later than two (2) months after theEffective Date, recruit and thereafter maintain, throughout the Project implementation period, for each seven (7) Regional Offices:(i) a regional coordinator; (ii) a monitoring and evaluation specialist; (iii) a social specialist; (iv) an environmentalspecialist; and (v) an accounting assistant; all with terms of reference, qualifications and experience satisfactory to theAssociation.
